subject: English
question_text: Complete the following text with right forms of the verbs given in the box. 0.5  10 =
stimulus: ensure create waste divide remain do appear save execute end Proper time management makes it possible to complete any work timely. If a person (a) ⎯⎯ his works into smaller portions and (b) ⎯⎯ them accordingly, the whole work will be (c) ⎯⎯ in time. Time is not (d) ⎯⎯ because of doing the work in a planned way. As a result, enough time (e) ⎯⎯. Besides proper use of time (f) ⎯⎯ by doing the work in this process. As each piece of work (g) ⎯⎯ quickly, opportunity to do additional works (h) ⎯⎯. Again due to time management, no part of work (i) ⎯⎯ difficult and no work (j) ⎯⎯ pending.
guide_solution: (a) confined (b) are (c) developed (d) adapting (e) receiving (f) becoming (g) working (h) are (i) are contributing (j) keeping
